dataset: Monthly Consumer Price Index (2018=100) - Tables of price indices

series.name: Consumer Price Index, all items (headline)
series.definition: Monthly index of the prices of the DoS consumer basket (~850 items); not 'the cost of living'.
series.seasonal_adjustment: Not stated by DoS; treated as not seasonally adjusted.
transformations: Extracted the 'All Items' row of each yearly DoS workbook (months located by header text).
No interpolation, smoothing, seasonal adjustment or gap filling.
Values kept at full published precision.

disclaimer: Independent research project - not an official Department of Statistics product. Forecasts are statistical projections, not official estimates.
